epics.title: Full Stack Docker Compose Setup
epics.jtbd: When a system operator wants to observe the running product, I want to launch the full stack via docker-compose with a health-check endpoint, so that the system can be verified in a real environment rather than just assuming builds pass.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of successful local full-stack deployments from 0% to 100%.
requirements: R1: Create a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml with health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker-compose setup for this epic, I want to define the services and health-check endpoints in a single file, so that the full stack can be launched reliably.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh clone of the repository, When the command docker-compose up is executed, Then all backend, frontend, and database containers should start successfully without errors.
Given the stack is running, When a GET request is made to the exposed health-check endpoint, Then the system returns an HTTP 200 OK status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container startup failure rate from 100% to 0%.
